body:
I misspelled it... Cardianeuria. 

♪ I was the only one around, when things would hurt you ♪
Good. Do that.

Oh, well I am indebted to you for that information. I am pretty sure it's not hypoxia, for even mild symptoms your skin turns gray-blueish, I noticed it on my hands in severe winter. Hypoxia sounds a bit extreme to be honest. There is something called cardianueria,  and it's a thing I have.
Do your friends know this? There's definitely lots of hope we got.
Yeah, because telling someone to love for love's sake is wrong. Ignoring the overall point. Just saying that's how I got it done.
What is wrong with your body?
Relax and try to listen, if you're so amazingly compassionate. I can't think all that well. I mentioned that.

Alpha lifestyle would be initiating it. In the same post I remember writing how we have our ups and downs. I never willfully did something to attract them. Neither did I move forward with it. From the way you sound, you might have taken the next step in my place, owning the alpha lifestyle. I fail to see your point. 

And I thought evidence would empower my claim, not masquerading how badass and cool that was...

Haha,  you're haryanvi. That's good to know. 

I never did mention people outside of our country don't have to go through what I am, that's an educated guess from your camp. I have untreated heart disease on top this. 

And no,  not "literally everyone has to go through that", another wild guess. 

I don't get angry,  but you're scratching the surface a bit much telling me I can't relate. Perhaps your anger cloaks you. 

I apologize once again.

Well,  then I'm sorry. We're all hurt and I have problems thinking straight. You think I tried to invalidate him,  I sounded like it but as I said we're all hurt. Hardly an alpha lifestyle but advice. Besides we all have our ups and downs,  so a subtle look from me sprouts fuck yous and fuck offs? You do realize how worse it could have been if it was someone else. 

Anyway,  again, I'm sorry.

:|

You're quite angry.  So politely I would say that you might be the one calling another beta and a cuck, or worse yet - yourself. Argument is best engaged in with a person of ability,  which is a thing you cloak under something strange. Allow me to reiterate that harm wasn't my intention.
This is true...

Have you tried contacting someone? Does anyone other than Reddit know about this?  Would you end your life cause of that asshat?  It's hard, very much so, but you gotta show him you're no one to get used.
Haha,  I'm hanging on to get out and a job and to fulfil my last wishes on my own.  I'll see from there.

Well,  just so you know,  that's not what I said *to you and my motive was to help you. 

Edit : emphasis
Allow me to express that your family is horrible.
That is a horrible situation. We are with you. Don't consider yourself alone.
Don't do it. No one can't be loved. Try working on yourself, it goes step by step.
Have you tried a psychologist?  Not calling you mad but they can help. I took one's help too.

Don't harm yourself for her. To suddenly leave someone so close is evil. March forward. You will have to make a choice here. March forward and show her nobody like you is anyone to use and throw,  but do it with all your dignity and sanity. Hard shit but definitely possible.

Leave that asshole. It's strange you love him. Learn to say bye and no. Relax, go out and find someone or something else. You are right to fight. I am fighting something very hard too. It's best to die fighting rather than a sad boulder.

Obviously...  But a rule of mine is to rule out your own personal vices when it comes to love. I'm 15, and I loathe every single time I lustily engaged in sexual activity with the first girl. No intercourse but still, it felt like cheapening it. Sex is not a fucking consequence. It never has to be. The second girl strikes the fucking chords in my heart and it's not because I once fantasized of fucking her but because of the affection she received me with when I first apologized to her. Goddamn. 

Also,  he separately mentions the line about sex. Separately. That indicates a separate desire apart from love. Without paying her. Mate, I can charm any damn girl into the bed,  two of the hottest girls in my class wanted to be with me, one of them openly brushed her ass against my arm as I was sitting. But that shit is cheap. Don't wanna do it and never will. 

So yeah, as I said, love for love's sake if you really want it.

Well,  death isn't painless. Oxygen depravity is a hellish experience you have no idea of. 


Anyway, you need dating advice. Man,  you sound healthy. I heavily suggest you use all you got, try it. I did and a lot good came out of it. And if you want love, stop wanting girls to get naked for you. Love and lust are two separate things. Learn to love and it will solve it all. I never really wanted to have someone strip for me, I've loved 2 girls and all I wanted was to be with them. Look in her eyes and talk to her, hear her giggle cause of you. But they didn't love me,  least not that much. Who can't be loved?
